cases.situation: Coworker Raj asked me to take his on-call shift the weekend of Oct 17. I've already covered for him twice this quarter and that's my son's football tournament.
cases.reply: I can see you need the weekend of the 17th covered. I can't take it this time, it's my son's football tournament. Elena mentioned last week she wanted extra on-call hours, so she might be worth asking.
cases.note: The referral is only there because it is real; skip it if you don't have one.

cases.situation: 表哥找我借5万说要做生意，之前借的2万到现在也没还。不想借，但他是我舅舅的儿子，不好撕破脸。
cases.reply: 哥，你开口我知道不容易。这次我不借，我给自己定过规矩，亲戚之间不借钱，对谁都一样。你要是想找人一起把生意的账算一算，我可以陪你看看。
cases.note: 用"规矩"而不是"没钱"，对方就没法在理由上讨价还价；之前那两万另找时间说，别混在这条里。

cases.situation: A former client keeps asking me (graphic designer) to 'quickly' tweak his logo for free. I said no, now he's replied 'wow, after all the business I sent your way'.
cases.reply: I understand you're disappointed, Greg, and I do appreciate the referrals. My answer's the same. If you'd like to book the tweaks, it's a one-hour job at $90 and I can fit it in this week.
cases.note: After a guilt-trip, don't re-explain. State it once, keep the paid option, then stop replying on that thread.

cases.situation: My mother-in-law, Carol, asked if we'll host Christmas again this year, 14 people. We've done it three years running and I'm worn out. Want to say no by text but still contribute something.
cases.reply: Hi Carol, thanks for thinking of us. We're going to pass on hosting Christmas this year; after three years in a row we'd love a turn as guests. We're happy to bring the ham and the desserts wherever it ends up, and I can come early on the 24th to help set up. Love to you both.
cases.note: A real smaller yes, the food and the setup, keeps the no generous. Don't nominate another host; that's her call.

cases.situation: An ex-colleague, Josh, asked me to be a reference for a job at Carver Group; his final interview is Thursday. We only worked together on one project and honestly I wasn't impressed with his work. I want to say no without trashing him.
cases.reply: Hi Josh, thanks for thinking of me, and congrats on getting to the final round at Carver. I'm going to say no to being a reference this time. We only worked together on the one project, so I couldn't give them the detail a strong reference needs. Priya, who managed you on the rollout, would do you far more good. Good luck on Thursday.
cases.note: Declining a reference: give the true reason that doesn't judge the work, and point to someone better placed.

cases.situation: Denise, the PTA chair at my kids' school, asked me to be treasurer this year. I've run the bake sale for 3 years, but I'm back at work full time now and I don't want a role with weekly hours.
cases.reply: Thanks for thinking of me, Denise, I can see the treasurer spot needs filling. I'm going to say no to that one; with a full-time job this year I can't take on a role with weekly hours. I can still run the bake sale table on Saturday 7 November, if that helps.
cases.note: A true reason that isn't up for debate, and a smaller yes that's real. Skip the offer if you don't actually want the bake sale either.

cases.situation: 市场部的周经理在公司四十多人的大群里@我，让我这周末把他们双十一活动的海报赶出来。我是品牌组的设计，这周排期已经满了，下周一倒是能排进来；按公司流程，这类需求本来要走设计需求单。
cases.reply: 周经理，收到，看得出双十一这边时间很紧。这周末的海报我接不了，本周的排期已经排满了。下周一我可以排进来，您这边提一张设计需求单，我周一上午第一个看。
cases.note: 在大群里被当众@：回得简短、不带情绪，不在群里讲道理；更小的yes是真实的档期，并指向公司自己的流程，细节再私聊。

cases.situation: My friend Jordan asked me to be the guarantor on his new apartment lease, $2,400 a month. I love him, but I don't co-sign anything for anyone. He's texting me and the lease signing is Friday.
cases.reply: I can tell how much you want this place, and I'm glad you asked me straight. I'm going to say no to being your guarantor. I don't co-sign leases or loans for anyone, family included; it's a rule I keep so money never sits between me and people I care about. If it helps, I'm free tonight to help you ask the landlord whether a larger deposit could replace a guarantor before Friday.
cases.note: A rule, not a comment on his finances, leaves nothing to argue with. Only offer the help tonight if you actually mean to give it.

cases.situation: My manager Karen asked if I'd organise the team holiday party again this year. I've done it the last two years, and our Q4 product launch is on December 8. I want to say no without looking like I'm not a team player.
cases.reply: Thanks for thinking of me, Karen. I'm going to pass on organising the holiday party this year; with the launch on 8 December I wouldn't give it the attention it deserves. I'm happy to hand last year's venue contacts and budget sheet to whoever takes it on, and walk them through it in 20 minutes.
cases.note: To a manager, tie the no to a priority she already owns and make the handover the smaller yes. If she says the party matters more, ask which should slip.

cases.situation: 对门邻居刘先生，平时就电梯里点个头，今天敲门问我国庆10月1号到7号能不能帮他们照看家里的两只猫，每天上门喂一次、铲屎。我国庆在家，但不想担这个责任，万一猫出事说不清。
cases.reply: 刘先生您好，谢谢您信得过我。照猫这件事我就不接了，别人家的宠物我一向不帮忙照看，怕万一有情况担不起。小区门口的'喵星球'宠物店有上门喂养服务，您可以去问问。国庆愉快！
cases.note: 不太熟的邻居：用一条规矩拒绝，不用编理由；有真实可用的去处就给一个，简短收尾。

cases.situation: Mi cuñado Andrés me pidió prestado el coche una semana, del 10 al 17 de octubre, para irse a la costa con unos amigos. No presto el coche a nadie y el seguro solo me cubre a mí.
cases.reply: Andrés, gracias por preguntarme directamente. Te voy a decir que no: el coche no lo presto, es una regla que tengo con todo el mundo, y además el seguro solo me cubre a mí. Si te sirve, te paso el contacto de la agencia donde alquilé el verano pasado, tenían buen precio por semana. ¡Que lo paséis genial en la costa!
cases.note: Una regla para todos es difícil de discutir; la alternativa es pequeña y real. Si insiste: 'Te entiendo, pero mi respuesta es la misma'.

cases.situation: My friend Ben asked me to help him move out of his third-floor walk-up on Saturday October 10. I don't want to spend the day carrying boxes, but I'm free that evening and would genuinely like to help in some other way.
cases.reply: Thanks for asking me, Ben, and congrats on the new place. I'm going to say no to the carrying on Saturday. I can come over that evening with pizza and help build the bed and unpack the kitchen, if that's useful.
cases.note: No reason owed for the no; the evening help is the smaller yes, and it's only there because you actually want to give it.

cases.situation: 表姨让我帮她儿子在我们公司内推，还想让我跟HR打个招呼“关照一下”。表弟专业不太对口，我不想去打招呼，但也不想让表姨觉得我不帮忙。
cases.reply: 表姨，我知道您是为表弟着急。跟HR打招呼这件事我不能做，公司招人我一向不插手，对谁都一样。表弟要是想试试，我把官网上正在招的岗位链接发给他，他自己投简历就行，投之前我可以帮他看一眼简历。
cases.note: 拒绝的是“打招呼”，用一条对谁都一样的规矩；发链接和看简历是真能给的小帮助，不想做就别提。
